PoPs are portable typed records (UA-8 P1, typed-signing TS-D1 / TS-D3; smartcontracts/vectors/ua/portable.json typed.*): popDigest = portableRecordDigest = typed(UAPortableRecord{ua, kind, 0, UAKemRecord{ua, 0, 0, 0}}), message = ua_msg(kind, pop v2, registrationDigest = typed(UARegistration{record, 0})), the same in every context (popOther repeats pop under context B for its consumers); chain-bound-pop / pop-v1-purpose: the pre-UA-8 PoP and the v1 purpose are refused. The scaas Schnorr transcript and the bn254 mapToG1 have no independent second implementation: clients/ua-rs agreeing on them is self-consistency only (accounts.md §1.16). msig auth = abi.encode(bytes keyData, bytes sig) (§1.9), sig = abi.encode(MemberSig[]) with an empty keyData in every MemberSig (CTR-UA-33: the registry reads a registered member's key from its record; a non-empty one is refused). webauthn-p256 abi-* negatives: the blob is accepted only as its canonical abi.encode(authenticatorData, clientDataJSON, r, s) (CTR-UA-33 C); all but the two length-word rows decode leniently to the positive's own fields.
